body_goal_start_valid.name: body_goal_start_valid
body_goal_start_valid.value: "body_goal"."start_source" = 'first_entry' or ("body_goal"."start_weight_g" is not null and "body_goal"."start_on" is not null)

client_goal_owner_valid.name: client_goal_owner_valid
client_goal_owner_valid.value: ("client_goal"."origin" = 'coach' and "client_goal"."coach_client_id" is not null and "client_goal"."user_id" is null) or ("client_goal"."origin" = 'self' and "client_goal"."user_id" is not null and "client_goal"."coach_client_id" is null)

assignment_member_active_unique.name: assignment_member_active_unique
